notes: Includes mandatory payroll deductions that apply to most employees at the federal level. State and local taxes are jurisdiction-specific and NOT included here. This dataset includes federal income tax (marginal withholding tables simplified as brackets), Social Security (employee), Medicare (employee) and Additional Medicare surtax. This is research-based but please verify against official sources before using for tax reporting.
